requirement: Objective req 1 sub-item: viking URI MD ingestion — user pulls third-party data already stored as MD into viking, points at a viking:// URI, and the system performs the same vector construction as PDF parsing with retrieval traceability where multiple chunks point back to that URI.
verdict: CAPABILITY CONFIRMED: write path auto-dispatches semantic+vector indexing for MD; retrieval returns URI-rooted chunks. No new code required this round.

mechanism.ingest_entry: POST /api/v1/content/write (openviking/server/routers/resources content router) — response carries semantic_status=queued / vector_status=queued; indexing is auto-dispatched on write, no manual reindex call needed.
mechanism.d2_reindex_contract: tests/enterprise_kb/test_parent_child_recall.py:296 test_reindex_markdown_skips_parser_and_does_not_rewrite_source proves: reindex of existing Markdown builds the layered chunk plan from original bytes, never invokes ParserRouter.parse (guarded by AssertionError), never rewrites source (fs.write_file assertion), and enqueues messages whose uri and source_uri both equal the source viking:// URI.
mechanism.why_add_resource_not_needed: HTTP add_resource path only accepts remote URLs or temp_file_id (openviking/server/local_input_guard.py require_remote_resource_source rejects viking:// shape), which is correct — the source data is already IN viking, so content/write + auto semantic dispatch is the entry, matching the objective's '拉过来存储到了viking上面但我们没有去做解析' scenario.

live_probe.multi_chunk_note: Three section-level queries each ranked pump_fault_notes.md first with 1-2 matched chunks per hit group; all hits return the source viking URI in result.uri — traceability requirement satisfied.
live_probe.mixed_corpus_context: Manual's section_*.md chunks also appeared with 0.72-0.86 scores, demonstrating the new MD competes correctly inside the existing layered vector + BM25 corpus rather than being isolated.

code_paths.write_dispatch: openviking/service/resource_service.py add_resource -> _submit_resource_ingestion (HTTP write router routes to same resource service); content/write handler sets semantic_status/vector_status queued
code_paths.md_indexing: openviking/service/reindex_executor.py _reindex_resource_vectors_from_entries files=[URI] path; openviking/utils/embedding_utils.py queue plan from read_file bytes

truthful_boundaries: Probe used a hand-written 462-byte Chinese MD with 3 sections; matches are grouped per query but total distinct chunk count for the doc was not enumerated from the vector store (chunks_in_group is per-hit-group from search API).
The D2 no-parser/no-rewrite guarantees are proven by unit test with mocked fs; live probe confirms end-to-end retrieval but not byte-level non-rewrite of the stored file.
Image-bearing external MD (chunk-level image summary for md-embedded pictures) was not exercised here; office/pdf image preservation evidence lives in I051/I053.
